paragraphs.text: Jem Lightfoote , also known as the Sky Explorer , is a Atiin scout from an unknown plane.

Jem debuted as a character in Outlaws of Thunder Junction . She is from an unknown plane that arrived on Thunder Junction after the opening of the Omenpaths . She is a member of the Atiin . Jem uses artificial wings for her scouting activities, preferring to see every corner of every location the Atiin stop at.
